_comment: idTech3 engines vendor their own zlib + libjpeg (jpeg-6) and use their own sound mixer, so the dependency surface is intentionally near-empty. zlib/libjpeg come from Emscripten ports at link time if the vendored copies fight clang; SDL is NOT used (we write a native emscripten/html5.h platform layer). Add recipes here only if a specific engine needs an external lib (e.g. libogg/libvorbis for streamed music).
